ios.desc:
Get ready for spooky season and share some laughs with JibJab! Create personalized greeting cards, videos, GIFs and AI Photo Packs that make your Halloween extra special.

Our legendary Ecards are always a hit, but this Halloween, surprise your friends and family with the funniest AI images using Starring You® AI Image Packs. With just one photo, you can swap yourself or loved ones into creepy and hilarious Halloween-themed pictures. Spreading frights and smiles has never been easier—no last-minute bedsheet ghosts required!

Celebrating 23 years of being the #1 app for ecards and funny personalized videos!

Come and see why over 84 MILLION people use JibJab to make awesome funny videos, GIFs, Ecards, greetings and OUR BRAND NEW STARRING YOU® AI Art!

A FUN ECARD TO SHARE FOR ANY HOLIDAY

* Halloween
* Thanksgiving
* Christmas
* Hanukkah
* New Years
* Valentine’s Day
* St. Patrick's Day
* Easter
* Mother’s Day
* Father’s Day
* 4th of July

and more!

SPECIAL OCASSION? WE HAVE IT ALL!

* Graduations
* Anniversaries
* Apologies
* Cheer
* Anniversaries
* Love

or just to cheer up your loved ones – we've got Ecards, GIFs and videos for that!

JOIN THE MILLIONS CREATING WITH JIBJAB

* The LARGEST collection of funny videos, Ecards and GIFs to personalize
* Now introducing CUTTING EDGE AI art generation to put you or your loved ones into hilarious scenes!
* FRESH content and updates all the time
* Family Fun - Upload pictures of the whole family to make funny group videos
* One-Tap Sharing - Post to social media or save to your camera roll

HOW IT WORKS:

1. Snap a Selfie - Of you, family members, or even your pet.
2. Stick your face in it - Select the perfect Ecard, GIF, video or roll the dice with one of our ridiculously fun Starring You® AI photo packs!
3. Get the LOLs - Share with family and friends in seconds!

SUBSCRIPTION:

Enjoy premium Ecards and music videos with a JibJab membership. Share any or all of our 1,500+ exclusive Ecards, GIFs, videos and Starring You® AI photo packs via our app and website.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Memberships automatically renew for $6.99 each month or $35.99 per year unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You may manage your auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.

Free GIFs are always there for you to view and share. For the complete terms, see: JibJab’s Terms of Sale: https://www.jibjab.com/te
